acceptance_criteria.name: Onboarding carousel
acceptance_criteria.evidence: app/onboarding/page.tsx: 3 slides (Order Ahead / Real-Time Alerts / No Delivery Fees), swipe + Prev/Next keyboard nav, Skip on all slides, Get Started on final, localStorage flag snakzap_onboarded, redirect to / when set, role=region + aria-roledescription=carousel, motion-reduce:transition-none

acceptance_criteria.name: Real scannable QR code
acceptance_criteria.evidence: components/QrCode.tsx rewritten with qrcode package; payload JSON.stringify({orderId, otp, v:1}); EC level 'H'; 200x200 SVG; tap-to-enlarge fullscreen modal with Max Brightness, large monospace OTP, Copy OTP; scannability proven by jsQR decode round-trip in lib/qr.test.ts

acceptance_criteria.name: Order History + Re-Order
acceptance_criteria.evidence: GET /api/v1/orders (page/limit zod-validated, defaults 1/10, total+pages, restaurant_name joined) in apps/api/src/routes/orders.ts; app/orders/page.tsx cards with restaurant/date/items/total/status; Reorder -> POST /api/v1/orders/reorder + cart pre-fill; skeleton loaders aria-busy=true; 6 new API route tests

acceptance_criteria.name: Cross-restaurant cart warning + Undo
acceptance_criteria.evidence: useCartStore.addItem returns discriminated result with snapshot; warning toast 'Starting a new order from [New]. Your [N] items from [Old] were cleared.' with Undo action restoring via restoreSnapshot()

acceptance_criteria.name: Add-to-cart loading states
acceptance_criteria.evidence: CustomizationPicker confirm shows spinner, disabled + aria-busy while processing; 300ms green checkmark; ref-guard prevents concurrent duplicate taps; menu row flashes green check

acceptance_criteria.name: Toast system
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Single Toaster in ToasterHost (components/ToasterHost.tsx): top-center mobile, bottom-right desktop, max 3 visible, role=alert + aria-live=assertive

tests.coverage_notes: onboarding(8), order-history(6), add-flow/cross-restaurant/I-07(3), QrCode component(4), QR jsQR roundtrip(3); API paginated orders(6)
